		Top = 94, ;
		ZOrderSet = 13
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaImportacion")
		thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas","Tg_Tabla","Marcas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRubros","Tg_Tabla","Rubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblSubRubros","Tg_Tabla","SubRubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblOrigenes","Tg_Tabla","Origenes","Clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewDespachoMovimientos","Tg_ViewDespachoMovimientos")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(7,8,0,0,0)
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsCompImportacion",thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarCompImportacion(thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Id_sistema"),thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		lParameters cId_Articulo,cId_Despacho,cId_Origen
		
		thisform.id_Articulo=cId_Articulo
		thisform.id_despacho=cId_despacho
		thisform.id_Origen=cId_Origen
		
		thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(thisform.Id_articulo)
		thisform.oTblMarcas.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca"))
		thisform.oTblRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro"))
		thisform.oTblSubRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_SubRubro"))
		thisform.oTblOrigenes.Buscar(thisform.Id_Origen)
		
		ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption=thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre") +"   "+"("+alltrim(thisform.Id_Articulo)+")" 
		ThisForm.oLblNombreMarca.Caption=thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreSubRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreDespacho.Caption=cId_Despacho
		ThisForm.oLblNombreOrigen.Caption=thisform.oTblOrigenes.Leer("Nombre")
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Refrescar(thisform.Id_Articulo,thisform.Id_Despacho,thisform.Id_Origen,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".NombreSistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".CantidadEntrada"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".CantidadSalida"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewDespachoMovimientos.Alias+".Saldo"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_COMMANDBUTTON1.Click
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaImportacion")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas","Tg_Tabla","Marcas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRubros","Tg_Tabla","Rubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblSubRubros","Tg_Tabla","SubRubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewStockDespacho","Tg_ViewStockDespacho")
		
		ThisForm.oLblNombreMarca.Caption=""
		ThisForm.oLblNombreRubro.Caption=""
		ThisForm.oLblNombreSubRubro.Caption=""
		ThisForm.oLblStockGral.Caption=""
		ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption=""
		**thisform.tg_Articulos1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos","TG_ConsDespachoMovimientos")				
		Endif
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos.MostrarMovimientos(thisform.Id_Articulo,thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Leer("Id_Despacho"),thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Leer("Id_Origen"))			
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Refrescar(thisform.Id_Articulo)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Alias+".Id_Despacho"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Alias+".NombreOrigen"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Alias+".Fecha_Ingreso"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Alias+".Saldo_Original"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Alias+".Saldo"
		ThisForm.oLblStockGral.Caption=alltrim(str(Round(thisform.oViewStockDespacho.Sumar("Saldo",".t."),2),8,2))
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		*!*	thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_articulos1.LostFocus
		DODEFAULT()
		
		IF !EMPTY(this.Value) AND !this.FormDesactivado 
			thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(this.Value)
		
			thisform.id_Articulo=this.Value
			thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(thisform.Id_articulo)
			thisform.oTblMarcas.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca"))
			thisform.oTblRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro"))
			thisform.oTblSubRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_SubRubro"))
				
			ThisForm.oLblNombreMarca.Caption=thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")
			ThisForm.oLblNombreRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Nombre")
			ThisForm.oLblNombreSubRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")
			ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption=thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre") 
		
			ThisForm.OCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .T.
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = !ThisForm.OCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		ENDIF
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		thisform.Cancelar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarMovimientos
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Imp_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Requerimientos","Tg_tabla","Imp_Requerimientos","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Cambioestado","Tg_tabla","Imp_Cambioestado","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion","Tg_ViewConsultaArticulosOperacion")
		
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFechaDesde.Value=      cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFechaHasta.Value=      cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaDesde.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaHasta.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaDesde.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaHasta.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboDesde.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboHasta.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.Filtrar("Af_Operacion and oApp.PedirPermiso('COM',id_Comproba,'A',oApp.CodSistema('Importacion'))")
		thisform.tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTblImp_Docu.IrPrimero
		
		Do while !thisform.oTblImp_Docu.EsEof()
		   if thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Pri_Docu") 
		       ThisForm.Tg_cmbcomprobantesImportacion1.SetearDefault(thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"))
		    endif
		   thisform.oTblImp_Docu.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloDesde= ""
		thisform.OldId_ArticuloHasta= ""
		thisform.OldId_Marca    = "TD"
		thisform.OldId_Rubro    = "TD"
		thisform.OldId_Subrubro = "TD"
		thisform.OldId_Comproba = thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.value
		thisform.OldFechaDesde  = thisform.tg_oTxbFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta  = thisform.tg_oTxbFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFecEntregaDesde= Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecEntregaHasta= Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFecSalidaDesde=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecSalidaHasta=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFecArriboDesde=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecArriboHasta=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboHasta.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarconsultaoperacion
		Local cTexto,oLst,vEstados, cId_Proveedor, vComprobantes
		cId_Proveedor= " "
		
		Dimension vEstados[Alen(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarEstadosOperacion1.vItems,1), Alen(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarEstadosOperacion1.vItems,2)] 
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarEstadosOperacion1.vItems,vEstados)
		Dimension vComprobantes[1,2]
		vComprobantes[1,1]= Thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.value
		vComprobantes[1,2]= .T.
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion") <> "O"			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion","TG_ConsultaOperacionesporArticulo" )				
		endif
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.RefrescarConsulta(thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.Leer("Id_Articulo"), @vComprobantes , @vEstados, thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.Leer("Detalle"), cId_Proveedor )			
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.Show()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		local vEstados, cId_ArticuloDesde, cId_ArticuloHasta, cId_Marca, cId_Rubro, cId_Subrubro,;
		      cId_Comproba, dFechaDesde ,dFechaHasta, dFecEntregaDesde ,dFecEntregaHasta, dFecSalidaDesde ,dFecSalidaHasta, dFecArriboDesde ,dFecArriboHasta,;
		      lEncontro_Estado
		      
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")= "O"
		   cId_ArticuloDesde = thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde   
		   cId_ArticuloHasta = thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		   cId_Marca    = thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		   cId_Rubro    = thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		   cId_Subrubro = thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		Else
		   cId_ArticuloDesde= " "
		   cId_ArticuloHasta= " "
		   cId_Marca    = "TD"
		   cId_Rubro    = "TD"
		   cId_Subrubro = "TD"
		Endif
		cId_Comproba = thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.value
		
		Dimension vEstados[Alen(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarEstadosOperacion1.vItems,1), Alen(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarEstadosOperacion1.vItems,2)] 
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarEstadosOperacion1.vItems,vEstados)
		
		*******************
		*!*	thisform.otblImp_Requerimientos.buscar(cId_Comproba,.F.,"Comproba")
		*!*	cId_Requerimiento= thisform.otblImp_Requerimientos.Leer("Id_Requerimiento")
		*!*	lEncontro_Estado= .F.
		
		*!*	For i= 1 to alen(vEstados,1)
		*!*	    if thisform.otblImp_Cambioestado.buscar(vEstados[i,1]+cId_Requerimiento,.F.,"Clave") .and. vEstados[i,2]= .T.
		*!*	       lEncontro_Estado= .T.     
		*!*	    Endif
		*!*	EndFor
		*!*	 
		*!*	If lEncontro_Estado 
		*!*	   If cId_ArticuloHasta  = " "
		*!*	      cId_ArticuloHasta= oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		*!*	   Endif
		*!*	else
		*!*	   cId_ArticuloDesde= " "
		*!*	   cId_ArticuloHasta= " "
		*!*	Endif
		
		if Empty(cId_ArticuloHasta)
		   cId_ArticuloHasta= oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		endif
		
		   dFechaDesde=      thisform.tg_otxbFechaDesde.value
		   dFechaHasta=      IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFechaHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFechaHasta.value )
		   dFecEntregaDesde= thisform.tg_otxbFecEntregaDesde.value
		   dFecEntregaHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFecEntregaHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFecEntregaHasta.value )
		   dFecSalidaDesde=  thisform.tg_otxbFecSalidaDesde.value
		   dFecSalidaHasta=  IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFecSalidaHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFecSalidaHasta.value )
		   dFecArriboDesde=  thisform.tg_otxbFecArriboDesde.value
		   dFecArriboHasta=  IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFecArriboHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFecArriboHasta.value )
		
		   thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
			
		   Thisform.SetearCursorespera()		
		
		   Thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.Refrescar(@vEstados, cId_ArticuloDesde, cId_ArticuloHasta, cId_Comproba, cId_Marca, cId_Rubro, cId_Subrubro ,dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, dFecEntregaDesde, dFecEntregaHasta, dFecSalidaDesde, dFecSalidaHasta, dFecArriboDesde, dFecArriboHasta )
		         
		   Thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.irprimero
		
		   thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		   Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.Alias+".Cantidad"       
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oViewConsultaArticulosOperacion.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-ThisForm.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(ThisForm.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		this.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcomprobantesimportacion1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value <> thisform.OldId_Comproba
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Comproba= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos") <> "O"
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.OldId_articuloDesde <> thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.OldId_articuloHasta <> thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.OldId_Marca <> thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.OldId_rubro <> thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.OldId_Subrubro <> thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		Endif	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarConsultaOperacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_oTxbFecArriboDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value <> thisform.OldFecArriboDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		thisform.OldFecArriboDesde= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

		Endif
		thisform.OldFecSalidaHasta= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarestadosoperacion1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarestadosoperacion1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

		TabIndex = 1, ;
		Top = 5, ;
		Tg_cmbmonedas1.Name = "Tg_cmbmonedas1", ;
		Tg_label1.Name = "Tg_label1", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Name = "oOpgTipoCotizacion", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option1.Left = 5, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option1.Name = "Option1", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option1.Top = 5, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option2.Left = 84, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option2.Name = "Option2", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option2.Top = 6, ;
		Tg_label2.Name = "Tg_label2"
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_varios.vcx" BaseClass="container" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_proveedores1' AS tg_proveedores WITH ;
		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 116, ;
		Name = "Tg_proveedores1", ;
		TabIndex = 4, ;
		Top = 34, ;
		valida = 1, ;
		Width = 93, ;
		ZOrderSet = 14
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clave.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_txbFecCotizaciondesde' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 331, ;
		Name = "Tg_txbFecCotizaciondesde", ;
		TabIndex = 8, ;
		Top = 63, ;
		Width = 75, ;
		ZOrderSet = 7
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_txbFecCotizacionHasta' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 473, ;
		Name = "Tg_txbFecCotizacionHasta", ;
		TabIndex = 9, ;
		Top = 63, ;
		Width = 75, ;
		ZOrderSet = 10
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("otblImp_Operaciones","tg_tabla","Imp_Operaciones","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Imp_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo","Tg_ViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		Thisform.tg_TxbFecCotizacionDesde.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbFecCotizacionHasta.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.Filtrar("Af_Operacion and oApp.PedirPermiso('COM',id_Comproba,'A',oApp.CodSistema('Importacion'))")
		thisform.tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.IrPrimero()
		thisform.oTblImp_Docu.IrPrimero
		
		Do while !thisform.oTblImp_Docu.EsEof()
		   if thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Pri_Docu") 
		       ThisForm.Tg_cmbcomprobantesImportacion1.SetearDefault(thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"))
		       ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.Tg_CmbMonedas1.value= thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Id_Mon_Visu")
		    endif
		   thisform.oTblImp_Docu.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		thisform.OldId_Articulos= thisform.Tg_Articulos1.value
		thisform.OldId_Proveedor= thisform.tg_Proveedores1.value
		thisform.OldId_Comproba=  thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.value
		thisform.OldFecCotizacionDesde=  Thisform.tg_TxbFecCotizacionDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecCotizacionHasta=  Thisform.tg_TxbFecCotizacionHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFormComprobante","Tg_ConsCompImportacion",thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),oApp.CodSistema("Importacion"),thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Leer("Nro_Referencia") )				
		Thisform.oFormComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		local cId_Articulo, cId_Proveedor, dFecCotizacionDesde ,dFecCotizacionHasta, cId_Comproba
		
		cId_Articulo = ThisForm.Tg_Articulos1.Value   
		cId_Proveedor= Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.value
		cId_Comproba=  Thisform.Tg_CmbComprobantesImportacion1.value
		
		dFecCotizacionDesde= thisform.tg_txbFecCotizacionDesde.value
		dFecCotizacionHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_txbFecCotizacionHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_txbFecCotizacionHasta.value )
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		Thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Refrescar(cId_Articulo, cId_Proveedor, dFecCotizacionDesde, dFecCotizacionHasta, cId_Comproba, ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(), ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion() )
		         
		Thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.irprimero
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias+".Nro_Operacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias+".Descripcion"       
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias+".Proveedor"     
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.Alias+".Precio_Base_Uni" 
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oViewConsultaCotizacionArticulo.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-ThisForm.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(ThisForm.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarconsulta
		local cMensaje, lValidado
		lValidado= .T.
		 
		if empty( thisform.Tg_Articulos1.value )
		        lValidado= .F.
		        cMensaje= "Debe Ingresar el Articulo! "
		endif
		   
		if !lValidado
		   =fMensAceptar(Alltrim(cMensaje))
		endif
		
		return lValidado   
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE CmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		if thisform.validarConsulta()
		   ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		   this.Enabled=.f.
		endif   
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_articulos1.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value <> thisform.OldId_Proveedor
		  ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Proveedor= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcomprobantesimportacion1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value <> thisform.OldId_Comproba
		  ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Comproba= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		thisform.Release
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.refrescarrenglon
		DODEFAULT()
		THISFORM.TG_GRID1.FONTSIZE= 8
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			  ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_proveedores1.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value <> thisform.OldId_Proveedor
		  ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Proveedor= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbFecCotizaciondesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value <> thisform.OldFecCotizacionDesde
		  ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
			
		thisform.OldFecCotizacionDesde= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbFecCotizacionHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.CmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value <> thisform.OldFecCotizacionHasta
		  ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFecCotizacionHasta= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Activate
		If thisform.ConsultaOperacion
		   thisform.ConsultaOperacion= .F.
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.AddObject("otblImp_Operaciones","tg_tabla","Imp_Operaciones","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsultaOperaciones","Tg_ViewConsultaOperaciones")
		
		thisform.tg_cmbEstados1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbEstados1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFechaDesde.Value=      cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFechaHasta.Value=      cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaDesde.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaHasta.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaDesde.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaHasta.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboDesde.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboHasta.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value=     cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value=     cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.tg_cmbDespachante1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbDespachante1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.tg_cmbFletesInt1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbFletesInt1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.tg_cmbTipoFletes1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbTipoFletes1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSeguros1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSeguros1.Value="TD"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbCondicionVta1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbCondicionVta1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde = Thisform.tg_oTxbFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta = Thisform.tg_oTxbFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFecEntregaDesde= Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecEntregaHasta= Thisform.tg_oTxbFecEntregaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFecSalidaDesde=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecSalidaHasta=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecSalidaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFecArriboDesde=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecArriboHasta=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecArriboHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoDesde=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoHasta=  Thisform.tg_oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value
		
		
		thisform.OldId_Estado=  thisform.tg_CmbEstados1.value
		thisform.OldId_Despachante= thisform.Tg_CmbDespachante1.Value
		thisform.OldId_FleteInter = thisform.Tg_CmbFletesInt1.value
		thisform.OldId_TipoFlete  = thisform.Tg_CmbTipoFletes1.value
		thisform.OldId_Seguro=  thisform.Tg_CmbSeguros1.value
		thisform.OldId_Proveedor=  thisform.tg_Proveedores1.value
		thisform.OldId_CondicionVta= thisform.Tg_CmbCondicionVta1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Banco= "TD"
		thisform.OldId_CondicionPago= "TD"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostraroperacion
		Local cTexto,oLst
		Thisform.ConsultaOperacion= .T.
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion") <> "O"			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion","TG_ConsultaOperacion" ,thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Leer("Nro_Operacion"),thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))				
		else
			thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.CargarConsultaOperacion(thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Leer("Nro_Operacion"),thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaOperacion.Show()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		local cId_Despachante, cId_FleteInter, cId_TipoFlete, cId_Seguro, dFechaDesde ,dFechaHasta
		local dFecEntregaDesde, dFecEntregaHasta, dFecSalidaDesde, dFecSalidaHasta, dFecArriboDesde, dFecArriboHastal
		local cId_Banco, cId_Proveedor, cId_CondicionVta, cId_CondicionPago, dFecVtoDesde, dFecVtoHasta,Anulado
		local cId_Pais, cId_Ciudad, dFecConocimientoDesde, dFecConocimientoHasta, dFecVtoPagoDesde, dFecVtoPagoHasta
		local cId_EmpresaInspeccion ,dFecVtoProrrogaDesde, dFecVtoProrrogaHasta, dFecVtoBancarioDesde, dFecVtoBancarioHasta
		local dFecEmisionSipDesde, dFecEmisionSipHasta, dFecRetiroCipDesde, dFecRetiroCipHasta
		local vSeleccion
		Dimension vSeleccion[1,2]
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbDespachante1.Value = "TD"
		    cId_Despachante= ""
		else
		    cId_Despachante= ThisForm.Tg_cmbDespachante1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbFletesint1.Value = "TD"
			cId_FleteInter= "" 
		else
		    cId_FleteInter= ThisForm.Tg_cmbFletesint1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbTipoFletes1.Value = "TD"
		    cId_TipoFlete= ""
		else
		    cId_TipoFlete= ThisForm.Tg_cmbTipoFletes1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbSeguros1.Value = "TD"
			cId_Seguro= ""
		else
		    cId_Seguro= ThisForm.Tg_cmbSeguros1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbCondicionVta1.Value = "TD"
		    cId_CondicionVta= ""
		else
		    cId_CondicionVta= ThisForm.Tg_cmbCondicionVta1.Value
		Endif
		
		If Type("thisform.oFormSeleccionEmbarque") <> "O"
		   cId_Pais= ""
		   cId_Ciudad= ""
		   dFecConocimientoDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		   dFecConocimientoHasta= oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		else
		   cId_Pais=   thisform.oFormSeleccionEmbarque.MostrarPais()
		   cId_Ciudad= thisform.oFormSeleccionEmbarque.MostrarCiudad()
		   dFecConocimientoDesde= thisform.oFormSeleccionEmbarque.MostrarFecConocimientoDesde()
		   dFecConocimientoHasta= thisform.oFormSeleccionEmbarque.MostrarFecConocimientoHasta()
		Endif
		
		If Type("thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago") <> "O"
		   cId_Banco= ""
		   cId_CondicionPago= ""
		   dFecVtoPagoDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		   dFecVtoPagoHasta= oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		   dFecVtoProrrogaDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		   dFecVtoProrrogaHasta= oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		   dFecVtoBancarioDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		   dFecVtoBancarioHasta= oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		else
		   cId_Banco= thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarBanco()
		   cId_CondicionPago= thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarCondicionPago()
		   dFecVtoPagoDesde=  thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarFecVtoPagoDesde()
		   dFecVtoPagoHasta=  thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarFecVtoPagoHasta()
		   dFecVtoProrrogaDesde= thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarVtoProrrogaDesde()
		   dFecVtoProrrogaHasta= thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarVtoProrrogaHasta()
		   dFecVtoBancarioDesde= thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarVtoBancarioDesde()
		   dFecVtoBancarioHasta= thisform.oFormSeleccionMedioPago.MostrarVtoBancarioHasta()
		Endif   
		
		If Type("thisform.oFormSeleccionPreembarque") <> "O"
		   cId_EmpresaInspeccion= ""
		   dFecEmisionSipDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		   dFecEmisionSipHasta= oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		   dFecRetiroCipDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		   dFecRetiroCipHasta= oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		else
		   cId_EmpresaInspeccion= thisform.oFormSeleccionPreembarque.MostrarEmpresaInspeccion()
		   dFecEmisionSipDesde=   thisform.oFormSeleccionPreembarque.MostrarEmisionSipDesde()
		   dFecEmisionSipHasta=   thisform.oFormSeleccionPreembarque.MostrarEmisionSipHasta()
		   dFecRetiroCipDesde=    thisform.oFormSeleccionPreembarque.MostrarRetiroCipDesde()
		   dFecRetiroCipHasta=    thisform.oFormSeleccionPreembarque.MostrarRetiroCipHasta()
		
		Endif
		
		dFechaDesde= thisform.tg_otxbFechaDesde.value
		dFechaHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFechaHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFechaHasta.value )
		
		dFecEntregaDesde= thisform.tg_otxbFecEntregaDesde.value
		dFecEntregaHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFecEntregaHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFecEntregaHasta.value )
		
		dFecSalidaDesde= thisform.tg_otxbFecSalidaDesde.value
		dFecSalidaHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFecSalidaHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFecSalidaHasta.value )
		
		dFecArriboDesde= thisform.tg_otxbFecArriboDesde.value
		dFecArriboHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFecArriboHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFecArriboHasta.value )
		
		dFecVtoDesde= thisform.tg_otxbFecVtoDesde.value
		dFecVtoHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_otxbFecVtoHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_otxbFecVtoHasta.value )
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_Estado",ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_Proveedor",Thisform.Tg_Proveedores1.value )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_Despachante",   cId_Despachante )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_FleteInter",    cId_FleteInter )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_TipoFlete",     cId_TipoFlete )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_Seguro",        cId_Seguro )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_CondicionVta",  cId_CondicionVta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_Pais",          cId_Pais )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_Ciudad",        cId_Ciudad )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecConocimientoDesde", dFecConocimientoDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecConocimientoHasta", dFecConocimientoHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_Banco",         cId_Banco )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_CondicionPago", cId_CondicionPago )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoPagoDesde",  dFecVtoPagoDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoPagoHasta",  dFecVtoPagoHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoProrrogaDesde",  dFecVtoProrrogaDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoProrrogaHasta",  dFecVtoProrrogaHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoBancarioDesde",  dFecVtoBancarioDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoBancarioHasta",  dFecVtoBancarioHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Id_EmpresaInspeccion", cId_EmpresaInspeccion )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecEmisionSipDesde",   dFecEmisionSipDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecEmisionSipHasta",   dFecEmisionSipHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecRetiroCipDesde",    dFecRetiroCipDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecRetiroCipHasta",    dFecRetiroCipHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FechaDesde",           dFechaDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FechaHasta",           dFechaHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecEntregaDesde",      dFecEntregaDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecEntregaHasta",      dFecEntregaHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecSalidaDesde",       dFecSalidaDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecSalidaHasta",       dFecSalidaHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecArriboDesde",       dFecArriboDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecArriboHasta",       dFecArriboHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoDesde",          dFecVtoDesde )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"FecVtoHasta",          dFecVtoHasta )
		=fGrabar(@vSeleccion,"Anulado",              lAnulado)
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Refrescar( @vSeleccion )
		         
		Thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.irprimero
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource 	=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Nro_Operacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Descripcion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Estado"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Proveedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Fecha_Arribo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Fecha_Entrega"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Fecha_Salida"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".Fecha_Vto"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperaciones.Alias+".CondicionVta"

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblImp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Imp_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo","Tg_ViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostraroperacion
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmOperacion") <> "O"			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmOperacion","TG_ConsultaOperacion" ,thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Leer("Nro_Operacion"),thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))				
		else
			thisform.oFrmOperacion.CargarConsultaOperacion(thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Leer("Nro_Operacion"),thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmOperacion.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Articulo, vComprobantes, vEstados, cDetalle, cId_Proveedor
		
		thisform.tg_txbArticulo.value= cDetalle
		if Alen(vComprobantes,1) > 1
		   thisform.tg_txbComprobante.value= "Todos"
		else
		   if Thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Buscar(vComprobantes[1,1],.f.,"Clave")
		      thisform.tg_txbComprobante.value= Thisform.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("nombre") 
		   endif
		endif   
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Refrescar(cId_Articulo, @vComprobantes, @vEstados, cId_Proveedor )
		         
		Thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.irprimero
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=	thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Alias+".Nro_Operacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Alias+".Descripcion"       
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Alias+".Proveedor"       
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource	= thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.Alias+".Cantidad"       
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oViewConsultaOperacionesporArticulo.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-ThisForm.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(ThisForm.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		thisform.Hide
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarOperacion()
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_seleccionarcomprobantesimportacion AS tg_lstselevariositems OF "tg_varios.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<PropValue>
		Name = "tg_seleccionarcomprobantesimportacion"
		Tg_listbox1.ColumnWidths = "15,30,190,60"
		Tg_listbox1.Name = "Tg_listbox1"
		Tg_3dshape1.Name = "Tg_3dshape1"
		oChkMarcaTodo.Name = "oChkMarcaTodo"
		Tg_label1.Caption = "Comprobantes"
		Tg_label1.Name = "Tg_label1"
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cFiltro,lMarcarTodo,lOperacion
		Local mmpp
		mmpp=0
		dodefault()
		this.AddObject("oTblStk_Docu","Tg_tabla","Stk_Docu","Clave")
		this.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		this.AddObject("oTblImp_Docu","Tg_tabla","Imp_Docu","Clave")
		
		If Type("cFiltro")=T_CHARACTER
			this.oTblImp_Docu.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		Endif
		
		IF This.oTblParametros.Leer("OrdenNombreSelccionComprobantes")
			this.oTblStk_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")
			this.oTblVnt_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")		
			this.oTblImp_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")		
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		this.oTblImp_Docu.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !this.oTblImp_Docu.EsEof()
			If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Importacion")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
				mmpp=mmpp+1
				this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)="Importación"
					
				Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
				this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblImp_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("Importacion")		
				this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
		
			Endif	
			this.oTblImp_Docu.IrSiguiente
			
		Enddo
		
		if !lOperacion
			this.oTblStk_Docu.Filtrar("Af_Importacion<>0")
		
			this.oTblStk_Docu.IrPrimero
		
			Do while !this.oTblStk_Docu.EsEof()
				If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblStk_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Stock")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
					mmpp=mmpp+1
					this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
					this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblstk_docu.Leer("id_comproba")	
					this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblstk_docu.Leer("Nombre")
					this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)="Stock"
					
					Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
					this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblstk_docu.Leer("id_comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("Stock")			
					this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
		
				Endif	
				this.oTblstk_docu.IrSiguiente
				
			Enddo
		
			this.oTblVnt_Docu.Filtrar("Af_Importacion<>0")
		
			Do while !this.oTblVnt_Docu.EsEof()
				If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
					mmpp=mmpp+1
					this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
					this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")
					this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
					this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)="Ventas"
						
					Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
					this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")		
					this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
					
				Endif	
				this.oTblVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente
			
			Enddo
		
		Endif
		
		this.tg_listbox1.Listindex=1
		If lMarcarTodo
			this.MarcarTodo
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_seleccionarestadosoperacion AS tg_lstselevariositems OF "tg_varios.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_txbFecConocimientoDesde' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 54, ;
		Name = "Tg_txbFecConocimientoDesde", ;
		TabIndex = 3, ;
		Top = 91, ;
		Width = 63, ;
		ZOrderSet = 7
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_txbFecConocimientoHasta' AS tg_textbox WITH ;
		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 199, ;
		Name = "Tg_txbFecConocimientoHasta", ;
		TabIndex = 4, ;
		Top = 91, ;
		Width = 63, ;
		ZOrderSet = 8
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />
	
	PROCEDURE asignarvalores
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldFecConocimientoDesde)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbFecConocimientoDesde.Value= thisform.OldFecConocimientoDesde
		Endif
		   
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldFecConocimientoHasta)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbFecConocimientoHasta.Value= thisform.OldFecConocimientoHasta
		Endif   
		
		Thisform.tg_CmbPais1.Value= thisform.OldPais
		Thisform.tg_CmbCiudades1.Value= thisform.OldCiudades
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciarcontroles
		Thisform.tg_TxbFecConocimientoDesde.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbFecConocimientoHasta.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		   
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbPais1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbPais1.Value = "TD"
		   
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbCiudades1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbCiudades1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.OldPais= "TD"
		thisform.OldCiudades= "TD"
		thisform.OldFecConocimientoDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldFecConocimientoHasta= cTod("  /  /  ")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		Thisform.iniciarcontroles()  
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarciudad
		local cId_Ciudad
		
		If thisform.tg_CmbCiudades1.Value = "TD"
		   cId_Ciudad= ""
		else
		   cId_Ciudad= thisform.tg_CmbCiudades1.Value
		Endif
		
		Return cId_Ciudad
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarfecconocimientodesde
		local dFecConocimientoDesde
		
		dFecConocimientoDesde= thisform.tg_TxbFecConocimientoDesde.value
		
		Return dFecConocimientoDesde
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarfecconocimientohasta
		local dFecConocimientoHasta
		
		dFecConocimientoHasta= IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_TxbFecConocimientoHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_TxbFecConocimientoHasta.value )
		
		Return dFecConocimientoHasta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarpais
		local cId_Pais
		
		If thisform.tg_CmbPais1.Value = "TD"
		   cId_Pais= ""
		else
		   cId_Pais= thisform.tg_CmbPais1.Value
		Endif
		
		Return cId_Pais
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbciudades1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.OldCiudades= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbpais1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.Tg_CmbCiudades1.Filtrar("Id_Pais = '" + thisform.Tg_CmbPais1.value+ "'")
		
		thisform.OldPais= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		thisform.Hide
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbFecConocimientoDesde.LostFocus
		thisform.OldFecConocimientoDesde= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbFecConocimientoHasta.LostFocus
		thisform.OldFecConocimientoHasta= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />

		Height = 21, ;
		Left = 228, ;
		Name = "Tg_txbVtoProrrogaHasta", ;
		TabIndex = 6, ;
		Top = 100, ;
		Width = 63, ;
		ZOrderSet = 8
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="textbox" />
	
	PROCEDURE asignarvalores
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldFecVtoPagoDesde)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbFecVtoPagoDesde.Value= thisform.OldFecVtoPagoDesde
		Endif
		
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldFecVtoPagoHasta)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbFecVtoPagoHasta.Value= thisform.OldFecVtoPagoHasta
		Endif   
		
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldVtoProrrogaDesde)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbVtoProrrogaDesde.Value= thisform.OldVtoProrrogaDesde
		Endif
		
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldVtoProrrogaHasta)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbVtoProrrogaHasta.Value= thisform.OldVtoProrrogaHasta
		Endif
		
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldVtoBancarioDesde)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbVtoBancarioDesde.Value= thisform.OldVtoBancarioDesde
		Endif
		
		IF !Empty(thisform.OldVtoBancarioHasta)
		   Thisform.tg_TxbVtoBancarioHasta.Value= thisform.OldVtoBancarioHasta
		Endif
		
		Thisform.tg_CmbBancos1.Value= thisform.OldBancos
		   
		Thisform.tg_CmbCondicionPago1.Value= thisform.OldMedioPago
		
		   
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciarcontroles
		Thisform.tg_TxbFecVtoPagoDesde.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbFecVtoPagoHasta.Value=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbVtoProrrogaDesde.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbVtoProrrogaHasta.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbVtoBancarioDesde.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.tg_TxbVtoBancarioHasta.Value= cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbBancos1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbBancos1.Value = "TD"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbCondicionPago1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbCondicionPago1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.OldFecVtoPagoDesde=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldFecVtoPagoHasta=  cTod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldVtoProrrogaDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldVtoProrrogaHasta= cTod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldVtoBancarioDesde= cTod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldVtoBancarioHasta= cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldBancos= "TD"
		thisform.OldMedioPago= "TD"
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		Thisform.iniciarcontroles()  
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarbanco
		local cId_Banco
		
		If thisform.Tg_cmbBancos1.Value = "TD"
		   cId_Banco= ""
		else
		   cId_Banco= thisform.Tg_cmbBancos1.Value
		Endif
		
		Return cId_Banco
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcondicionpago
		local cId_CondicionPago
		
		If thisform.Tg_cmbCondicionPago1.Value = "TD"
		   cId_CondicionPago= ""
		else
		   cId_CondicionPago= thisform.Tg_cmbCondicionPago1.Value
		Endif
		
		Return cId_CondicionPago
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarfecvtopagodesde
		local dFecVtoPagoDesde
		
		dFecVtoPagoDesde=  thisform.tg_TxbFecVtoPagoDesde.value
		
		Return dFecVtoPagoDesde
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarfecvtopagohasta
		local dFecVtoPagoHasta
		
		dFecVtoPagoHasta=  IIF( EMPTY(thisform.tg_TxbFecVtoPagoHasta.value), oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(), thisform.tg_TxbFecVtoPagoHasta.value )
		
		Return dFecVtoPagoHasta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvtobancariodesde
		local dFecVtoBancarioDesde
		
		dFecVtoBancarioDesde=  thisform.tg_TxbVtoBancarioDesde.value
		
		Return dFecVtoBancarioDesde
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvtobancariohasta
		local dFecVtoBancarioHasta
		
		dFecVtoBancarioHasta=  IIF(EMPTY(thisform.tg_TxbVtoBancarioHasta.value),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(),thisform.tg_TxbVtoBancarioHasta.value)
		
		Return dFecVtoBancarioHasta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvtoprorrogadesde
		local dFecVtoProrrogaDesde
		
		dFecVtoProrrogaDesde=  thisform.tg_TxbVtoProrrogaDesde.value
		
		Return dFecVtoProrrogaDesde
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvtoprorrogahasta
		local dFecVtoProrrogaHasta
		
		dFecVtoProrrogaHasta=  IIF(EMPTY(thisform.tg_TxbVtoProrrogaHasta.value),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(),thisform.tg_TxbVtoProrrogaHasta.value )
		
		Return dFecVtoProrrogaHasta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbbancos1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.OldBancos= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcondicionpago1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.OldMedioPago= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbfecVtoPagoDesde.LostFocus
		thisform.OldFecVtoPagoDesde= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbFecVtoPagoHasta.LostFocus
		thisform.OldFecVtoPagoHasta= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbVtoBancarioDesde.LostFocus
		thisform.OldVtoBancarioDesde= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbVtoBancarioHasta.LostFocus
		thisform.OldVtoBancarioHasta= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbVtoProrrogadesde.LostFocus
		thisform.OldVtoProrrogaDesde= this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_txbVtoProrrogaHasta.LostFocus
		thisform.OldVtoProrrogaHasta= this.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		Endif
